# talker_flutter

**Tag**: logger, error, report, tool, ui, mobile

## 简介

Advanced error handler and logger package for flutter and dart. App monitoring, logs history, report sharing, custom logs, and etc.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/Frezyx/talker
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/Frezyx/talker/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/talker_flutter
